title: Zarr v2 node metadata
description: A Zarr v2 group or array as one object: the content of its `.zgroup` or `.zarray` document with its `.zattrs` as `attributes` (Zarr storage specification 2, https://zarr-specs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/v2/v2.0.html). Zarr v2 stores these in separate documents and has no `node_type`; readers add it from the document that exists, as Zarr v3 does in `zarr.json`. Unofficial JSON Schema authored by hamk-uas/stac-schema-explorer to document and check metadata embedded in data files; it is not published or endorsed by the maintainers of the format or convention.

node_type.title: Node type
node_type.description: Whether the node has a `.zarray` (array) or a `.zgroup` (group) document. Not stored in Zarr v2; added by the reader.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: The node's `.zattrs` document: arbitrary user metadata. Conventions such as CF, ACDD and xarray's `_ARRAY_DIMENSIONS` define their fields here.

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Length of each dimension of the array.

dtype.title: Data type
dtype.description: NumPy type string of the elements, for example `<f4` (little-endian 32-bit float) or `|u1` (unsigned byte), or a list of fields for structured types.

compressor.title: Compressor
compressor.description: Primary compression codec, or null for uncompressed chunks.

id.title: Codec
id.description: numcodecs identifier of the codec, for example blosc, zstd, zlib or delta.

fill_value.title: Fill value
fill_value.description: Value of elements that have not been written, or null when undefined. Floats may be "NaN", "Infinity" or "-Infinity".

order.title: Memory layout
order.description: Order of elements within a chunk.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Codecs applied before the compressor, or null.

id.title: Codec
id.description: numcodecs identifier of the codec, for example blosc, zstd, zlib or delta.

dimension_separator.title: Dimension separator
dimension_separator.description: Character between chunk indices in chunk keys.
